name: Hasilpur

queries.query: Hasilpur Pakistan official cadastral map land records parcel map Bahawalpur
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Punjab Land Records Authority, the Punjab PULSE Urban Land Systems Enhancement map, the official Government of Punjab Bahawalpur administration page, the Local Government and Community Development Bahawalpur page identifying Tehsil Council Hasilpur, and the Punjab Local Government PMU Bahawalpur page listing Hasilpur land-use maps. The PULSE viewer's current JavaScript exposed a public ArcGIS token route and the Punjab_Cdastral_Maps service; a bounded exact-point query returned one polygon.

queries.result: اردو زبان میں پہلی پارٹی تلاش نے پنجاب لینڈ ریکارڈز اتھارٹی، پنجاب کے سرکاری لینڈ ریکارڈ/کادستر نقشہ سیاق، اور سرکاری بہاولپور ضلعی انتظامی و مقامی حکومت کے صفحات کی نشاندہی کی۔ PULSE کے سرکاری نقشہ کنفیگریشن سے پنجاب کادسترل میپس ArcGIS سروس ملی؛ غیر محفوظ ملکیتی فیلڈز طلب نہیں کیے گئے۔

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Government of Punjab local-government and Bahawalpur district administration context, including the official Local Government and Community Development listing for Tehsil Council Hasilpur; the PMU Bahawalpur page specifically lists Hasilpur land-use map resources.
officialSourceAssessment.provincialParcelService: Punjab PULSE viewer at https://lis.pulse.gop.pk/ with ArcGIS service https://gismaps.punjab-zameen.gov.pk/arcgis/rest/services/VendorMaps/Punjab_Cdastral_Maps/MapServer/2, layer name Bahawalpur.
officialSourceAssessment.nationalAgency: No national cadastral endpoint was used; Punjab provincial custodians are the relevant source for Hasilpur.
officialSourceAssessment.registryBasis: A first-party provincial cadastral map service is evidenced and its Bahawalpur layer returned native-ID polygon geometry at the exact unchanged WUP point; Hasilpur local-government context is separately evidenced. This supports registryFound=true for source discovery, not runtime adapter qualification.
officialSourceAssessment.registryFoundReason: The official PULSE/ArcGIS cadastral layer is public and queryable with a bounded anonymous request, and official Punjab/Bahawalpur pages identify Hasilpur's local administrative context.
